name: Benperidol
summary: Benperidol, sold under the trade name Anquil among others, is a typical antipsychotic primarily used to treat hypersexuality syndromes and can be used to treat schizophrenia. It is a highly potent butyrophenone derivative and is the most potent neuroleptic in the European market, with chlorpromazine equivalency as high as 75 to 100 (about 150 to 200% the potency per dose of haloperidol).

pharmacology.text: Benperidol is a strong dopamine receptor antagonist (D2 (Ki 0.027 nM) and D4 (Ki 0.066 nM)) with weaker serotonin receptor antagonism (5-HT2A (Ki 3.75 nM)). In high doses, it has antihistaminergic and alpha-adrenergic properties. It possesses minimal anticholinergic properties.

uses.text: Benperidol, sold under the trade name Anquil among others, is a typical antipsychotic primarily used to treat hypersexuality syndromes and can be used to treat schizophrenia. It is sometimes prescribed to sex offenders as a condition of their parole, as an alternative to anti-androgen drugs such as cyproterone acetate. Benperidol was discovered by Janssen Pharmaceutica in 1961 and has been marketed since 1966.

summaryZh: 苯哌利多,商品名Anquil等。為第一代抗精神病藥物，主要用於治療性慾亢進和精神分裂症。苯哌利多為一種強效丁醯苯衍生物，是歐洲市場上的強效神經安定藥，氯丙嗪當量達75-100%（約每劑量氟哌啶醇效力的150-200%）。有時被作為色普龍等抗雄激素藥的替代方案，作為假釋條件開給性罪犯者。
summaryZhHans: 苯哌利多,商品名Anquil等。为第一代抗精神病药物，主要用于治疗性欲亢进和精神分裂症。苯哌利多为一种强效丁酰苯衍生物，是欧洲市场上的强效神经安定药，氯丙嗪当量达75-100%（约每剂量氟哌啶醇效力的150-200%）。有时被作为色普龙等抗雄激素药的替代方案，作为假释条件开给性罪犯者。

sideEffects.en: Because it blocks dopamine so strongly, it commonly causes stiffness, tremor, restlessness and raised prolactin, which can cause breast swelling and loss of sex drive. Long-term use risks tardive dyskinesia, lasting involuntary movements.
sideEffects.zh: 由於它對多巴胺的阻斷極強，常造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安與泌乳素升高，後者可能導致乳房腫脹與性慾下降。長期使用有遲發性運動障礙的風險，即持續的不自主動作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于它对多巴胺的阻断极强，常造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安与泌乳素升高，后者可能导致乳房肿胀与性欲下降。长期使用有迟发性运动障碍的风险，即持续的不自主动作。

fact.en: Benperidol is among the most potent antipsychotics ever made, binding the dopamine D2 receptor extremely tightly. It came from the Janssen butyrophenone programme that also produced haloperidol.
fact.zh: 苯哌利多是有史以來效力最強的抗精神病藥之一，與多巴胺 D2 受體的結合極為緊密。它出自楊森的丁醯苯研究計畫，氟哌啶醇也來自同一計畫。
fact.zhHans: 苯哌利多是有史以来效力最强的抗精神病药之一，与多巴胺 D2 受体的结合极为紧密。它出自杨森的丁酰苯研究计划，氟哌啶醇也来自同一计划。
